senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זָלַג) [dripper,] fork for taking meat out of the caldron.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:2">Kel. XIII, 2</cite> <he>ניטל המ׳</he> (not <he>ניטלה</he>) if the forked head of the soup-ladle is broken off, v. <cite ref="G00186"><he>זוֹמִילִיסְטְרוֹן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:2">Sabb. XVII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 122b">122ᵇ</cite>), v. <cite ref="M01488"><he>מַלְגֵּז</he></cite>.
